summary: Macrostrat holds the core variables (ages of gap-bound packages per column, so hiatus lengths and package durations can be derived) openly under CC BY 4.0, with the densest coverage in North America. What the claim also needs, a partition of incompleteness among erosion, non-deposition, preservation and sampling, is not a field in any dataset; PBDB supplies collections for the sampling side only.
next_step: Pre-register a North American test on Macrostrat sections (distribution of derived gap durations vs package durations), with PBDB collections per package as the sampling covariate; treat the 'chief cause' wording as untestable without a model.
obstacles_confirmed: Macrostrat coverage is far denser in North America than elsewhere (project table).
No dataset partitions incompleteness by cause.
Sadler-type completeness compilations were not found in DataCite or Dryad.
